title: Caste: definitions, tribe link, more detail

boxes.title: More definitions of caste
head: Scholar
Definition
rows: Membership by birth + ban on marrying outside
Common name, mythical ancestor, same hereditary calling
Obligations, privileges fixed by birth; sanctioned by ==religion==

boxes.title: Caste vs tribe basics
items: Caste: birth-based institution ==unique to Indian society==; endogamy, hereditary occupation
Tribe: common territory, culture, language, ancestry; endogamy
**Surajit Sinha**: tribes = =="little tradition"== vs Hindu "great tradition"; **secondary state formation** (chiefs take Raja titles)
Ghurye: tribes as "**backward Hindus**"; contested by **Xaxa** and Elwin

boxes.title: Other features & points
items: Also: ascribed by birth, **commensal taboos**, pollution-by-touch, **caste panchayat** as a court
Dumont: religious status encompasses power; **Homo Aequalis** contrast
Jajmani: socio-economic & ritual; ==Pallava-era== barter of services
APPSC 2007: when caste "began"; key garbled, notes say **Later Vedic**

boxes.title: Non-Hindus, current angles
items: Christians: came with St Thomas, **52 AD**; about ==**74%**== identify with lower castes
**2009** genetic study: ==two ancestral populations==; caste creates biological differences
